name: Camp Grove Counselor-in-Training (Garden Grove)
org: City of Garden Grove Community Services Department
what_you_do: Help run Camp Grove, the city summer day camp for kids ages 5 to 12. You get hands-on experience and build leadership skills.
who_can_apply: Youth 13 to 17 years old. You must fill out the application yourself.
pay_detail: You pay $60 for each week. Week 8 costs $120 and week 9 costs $85, and those two fees are not refundable. The weekly cost includes the camp trip fee.
duration: Camp Grove runs 9 weeks. In 2026 it ran June 8 to August 7.
deadline_text: The 2026 application was due Monday, May 4, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Counselor-In-Training application linked on the program page. Fees are due two weeks before your assigned week. Call the recreation counter at 714-741-5200 to ask where to turn it in.
notes: This is a program you pay to join. It is not a paid job. Camp Grove is at Edgar Park, 12781 Topaz Street.
